summary: Use a RHEL DVD or ISO as a local repo: mount it at `/media/rheldvd` (`mount /dev/sr0` or `mount -o loop <iso>`), create `/etc/yum.repos.d/dvd.repo` with `dvd-BaseOS` and `dvd-AppStream` pointing at `file:///media/rheldvd/BaseOS` and `AppStream`, and `rpm --import /media/rheldvd/RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release`, or you get a curl error resolving www.redhat.com.
questions: How do I use a RHEL ISO as a repo for AAP?
Curl error 6 could not resolve www.redhat.com during dnf
dvd.repo example for BaseOS and AppStream

answer_card.title: RHEL DVD/ISO as a repo
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
mkdir /media/rheldvd && mount -o loop <rhel-dvd>.iso /media/rheldvd   # or: mount /dev/sr0
rpm --import /media/rheldvd/RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release
```
```ini
# /etc/yum.repos.d/dvd.repo
[dvd-BaseOS]
name=DVD for RHEL - BaseOS
baseurl=file:///media/rheldvd/BaseOS
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release

[dvd-AppStream]
name=DVD for RHEL - AppStream
baseurl=file:///media/rheldvd/AppStream
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release
```
